items.title: Congress could enter No Surprises Act fight - BenefitsPRO
items.reason: Congressional involvement in No Surprises Act disputes directly affects implementation and enforcement of the law, which is central to NSA litigation and regulatory developments affecting revenue-cycle operations.
items.summary: Congress may become involved in disputes surrounding the No Surprises Act's implementation, potentially influencing how the federal balance-billing protections are enforced and interpreted. Congressional action could alter the regulatory landscape established by HHS/CMS and affect ongoing litigation related to the law's requirements. This development matters for revenue-cycle teams because legislative changes could shift compliance obligations, IDR process rules, and balance-billing claim handling procedures that directly impact operations and financial performance.
